title.narrative: Cooperation between Georgian Revenue Service and Swedish Tax Agency
Cooperation between Georgian Revenue Service and Swedish Tax Agency

description.narrative: Skatteverket stödjer den the Georgian Revenue Service (GRS) för att stärka GRS institutionella kapacitet och öka skattebetalarnas efterlevnad.
Swedish Tax Agency supports the Georgian Revenue Service (GRS) in enhancing the institutional capacity of the GRS and increase compliance by taxpayers.

The Inception Phase crucial activity was Taxpayer Survey preparations involving both quantitative and qualitative parts. The preparations included working on methodology that was agreed with GRS. Target groups of the survey include large taxpayers (200 respondents), SME taxpayers (1500 respondents), and individuals (1000 respondents).
In parallel Swedish experts identified priority areas for Attitudes and taxpayer satisfaction towards E-services, including development of proactive feedback & communication campaigns Culture/attitude for front line officials. The Swedish experts involved gave highest priority Attitudes and taxpayer satisfaction survey to identify key concerns and mistrust. And the second priority area was: Improvements in e-services, focusing on user qualitative data collection.
Main Phase the company was selected for the survey (CRRC). Survey Implementation progressed with minor delays in fall 2024; The draft final report of the survey delivered in February 2025.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
